primary_population: independent confirmation roots 301-330, same sampling protocol as calibration roots 201-212
primary_endpoint: paired independent-audit selected deployment gain: pivot_kg minus uniform_v2_expected_100
primary_interval: two-sided 95% percentile bootstrap resampling 30 independent roots, 10000 draws, seed78131
primary_evidence_rule: lower confidence bound > 0 supports PIVOT-KG improvement over this matched-posterior Uniform comparator in this registered condition
other_comparisons: budgets1and4, response4, LUCB, IVR, Global-VOI heuristic, noHF, proxy-only and author-code variants are secondary; no unadjusted multiple-comparison superiority claims
author_features: four signed normalized candidate-minus-incumbent controller parameter differences: speed/20-1, headway/1.5-1, distance/5-1, lane_change_distance/15-1. No-update footprint and gain exactly zero. Separate model for each response search budget, trained on calibration only.
candidate_and_environment_policy: no outcome-based tuning or filtering; all six prespecified controller updates retained, even proxy-negative ones; report proxy-positive subset descriptively
HF_charge: response search adaptation*2 episodes once for incumbent plus each queried candidate; paired selection4 episodes costs8 perquery; fixedblock only, no menu or stopping claim
calibration_diagnostics: leave-one-root-out coverage including heldout audit measurement variance; diagnostic only, no posthoc parameter alteration
decision_sealing: hash complete decisions before opening independent confirmation audit; querycallback returns only the requested precomputed selection block
full_reporting: retain all null/negative conditions, engine errors, cost ledger, all roots, protocols and source hashes
author_reward_units: Author Bayesian prior is specified in average return per fixed planned decision step: all proxy/training/query gains divided by fixed horizon300 before author functions; final independent audit metrics converted/reported in original native cumulative-return units. No outcome-derived scale. Existing joint candidate posterior fits covariance/noise directly in native units.
author_prior_scale_reason: Avoid applying fixed prior precision1 to arbitrary cumulative reward units. Declared before reading pilot outcome or generating calibration/confirmation.
